journey.name: Add Recipe - Full Flow
journey.description: Test adding a new recipe: navigate from Home to editor, fill in recipe name and instructions, save, verify it appears in the list

actions.action: Tap the "Home" tab at the bottom of the screen
Verify the Recipe Editor page is displayed with input fields
Tap the recipe name input field and type "Test Journey Recipe"
Tap the instructions input field and type "Step 1: Mix all ingredients together. Step 2: Cook for 20 minutes."
Tap the save or submit button to save the recipe
Verify the app navigates back to the Home screen
Tap the "Load Recipes" button to refresh the list
Verify "Test Journey Recipe" appears in the recipe list
